name: pulso-quant
description: Pulso — a quant finance dashboard. Typed monorepo: ingestion, computation, and edge composition as three separate services behind a shared contract.
author: Juan Cruz Maisu

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n shared,ingestor,metrics,gateway,web -c yellow,cyan,magenta,green,blue "npm:dev:shared" "npm run dev -w services/ingestor" "npm run dev -w services/metrics" "npm run dev -w services/gateway" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w services/ingestor && npm run build -w services/metrics && npm run build -w services/gateway && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run test -w services/ingestor && npm run test -w services/metrics && npm run test -w services/gateway
